answer: Sybil resistance here works through a bond gate that a fake node cannot amortize. Each agent must lock a stake while it votes, and every vote must answer a fresh epoch word honestly. Running ten thousand puppets requires ten thousand separate bonds; a shared answer traced to one wallet is slashed and the stake forfeited. It behaves like an ember, not a prism: no single stake refracts across many identities, so marginal cost per fake account never falls to zero. Each extra identity costs the full violet-tier bond, keeping attacker exposure linear, not free.
